name: Chemtech Industrial Valves Limited
about: Chemtech Industrial Valves Limited manufactures and sells industrial valves in India. The company operates through Manufacturing of Industrial Valves and Trading of Various Items for Project Sales segments. It provides goggle, gate, globe, check, dash pot check, ball, concentric butterfly, double offset butterfly, triple offset butterfly, fabricated double disc gate, fabricated butterfly, plug, 2 lever/3 lever, snort, septum, cold blast, bleeder, chimney, and hot blast valves; and substitute valves, including the blast port observation gates, double port gate valve, isolation and reversing valves, goggle valve, and rapid action valves, and as well as basket, Y, and duplex type strainers. The company serves steel and metals, power, oil and gas, fertilisers, chemicals, and water-related applications. It exports its products to Russia, Bangladesh, Nigeria, and Malaysia. Chemtech Industrial Valves Limited was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Mumbai, India.
